title: 3rd Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/3/3/2026).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request, under Articles 115(f)(1) and 93(a) of the Constitution, for Parliament's approval for the Maldives to accede to the Optional Protocol to the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and deposit its instrument of accession is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Asset Recovery Bill (on property obtained through crime), submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent a disability-rights protocol to committee and continued debating the Asset Recovery Bill and a Criminal Procedure Act amendment.
